title: Association, causal review and authority are deliberately different
summary: No component in the ordinary Brand evidence/intervention chain may upgrade temporal or statistical association to causation by itself. Named external causal review, when present, is a separate authority path with explicit scope/evidence.
invariants: Interaction Event candidate triggers remain CANDIDATE_NOT_PROVEN.
Brand Interaction Effect association evidence remains ASSOCIATION_ONLY unless an authorised external causal process establishes more.
Journey recovery modifiers are strata, not treatment claims.
Effectiveness RANDOMIZED provenance is useful evidence but not self-authorizing causality.
Governance operates on evidence status without converting it into causal fact.

provenance.claim: Candidate triggers remain unproven and downstream domains retain authority.
Association evidence and cohort/statistical invariants never self-promote causality.
Effectiveness assignment design remains provenance only; analysis remains association-only.
